top_stories.title: ‘Super corruption government’ is coming to exist: Chalavadi Narayanaswamy - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Chalavadi Narayanaswamy**, leader of the Opposition in the Legislative Council, criticized the **BJP** for its handling of the dissolved government, alleging that corruption persists despite the change. He stated that officers continue to engage in corrupt practices and development projects remain stalled, emphasizing the need for systemic changes rather than superficial leadership shifts.  Narayanaswamy also accused the Congress of neglecting Dalits and failing to nominate a Dalit as Chief Minister.

top_stories.title: Europe airport chaos: UK travellers asked to arrive 3 hours early as border checks cause delays - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Passengers** travelling between the UK and several European destinations are facing delays due to the **European Union's Entry Exit System (EES)**, a new border management scheme requiring biometric data from non-EU travellers.  The system, which has recorded nearly 80 million entries and exits, is causing significant congestion at airports, particularly in Spain, Portugal, and France. **Airlines**, including **Wizz Air**, are advising passengers to arrive at least three hours before departure, while **Airports Council International (ACI Europe)** has called for improvements to border staffing levels and technical systems. Despite the challenges, the **European Commission** maintains that the system is largely functioning as intended.

top_stories.title: WHO chief visits epicentre of Ebola outbreak in DR Congo - World - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus**, **World Health Organization’s** director general, visited the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to assess the Ebola outbreak response. The highly contagious haemorrhagic fever has already spread to three provinces in DRC and neighboring Uganda, with at least 1,077 suspected cases reported.  The WHO is working with the **DRC government** to address challenges and ensure community ownership of the response.  While a patient recovered from the outbreak on Wednesday, marking the first case discharged after two negative tests, medical experts are still insufficiently deployed to the region. The outbreak is occurring in an unstable area with limited laboratory capacity and ongoing conflict, raising concerns about its spread within displacement camps.

top_stories.title: Egypt warns Israel that dangerous Gaza escalations threaten ceasefire | Gaza News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Egypt** has launched an urgent diplomatic intervention to salvage a fragile Gaza ceasefire agreement that is on the brink of collapse. **Israel**'s recent military attacks and statements threatening to unravel months of diplomacy have pushed the deal to the edge.  The Egyptian government warned **Israel** against expanding its occupation in Gaza, while also inviting a senior Hamas delegation led by chief negotiator Khalil al-Hayya for urgent talks. The diplomatic moves come amid a surge in deadly air strikes that have killed at least 141 Palestinians in the last two weeks and an Israeli directive to expand control from 53% to 70%.  **Egypt** is coordinating with mediators in Qatar, Turkey, and the US to return the process to a negotiating track.

top_stories.title: Government exempts import duty on cotton till October 30 - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Indian government** exempted all customs duties on cotton imports for five months, starting June 1st, 2026. This measure aims to increase cotton availability for the textile sector and reduce input costs for manufacturers and consumers. The move is expected to benefit small and medium enterprises in the industry while also considering the interests of domestic farmers.

top_stories.title: UK man, 68, dies rescuing granddaughter after family swept out to sea in Cornwall | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Phil Crow**, a 68-year-old grandfather, died while attempting to rescue his nine-year-old granddaughter, Sia Briskham, from rapidly changing sea conditions at Tregirls Beach in Cornwall, UK.  The incident occurred during a bank holiday weekend with unusually warm weather and saw **Tina Crow**, the granddaughter's mother, rescued by a passing boat and later checked by paramedics.  **Sia** was brought ashore by members of the public, while **Mr Crow** tragically succumbed to cardiac arrest despite efforts from emergency services including **Coastguard teams**, **the Rock RNLI lifeboat crew**, and **Cornwall Air Ambulance**.

top_stories.title: Rubio says Trump envoy Barrack to step down from Syria post | Politics News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Tom Barrack**, the US Special Envoy for Syria, will step down from his formal post but remain in a key diplomatic role managing US policy in Syria and Iraq.  **Marco Rubio**, **Secretary of State**, announced this transition, highlighting Barrack's expertise and understanding of the "America First" agenda. While Barrack's special envoy title has expired, he will continue to coordinate these three areas of focus for the Trump administration. The move signals a desire for continuity in US policy towards Syria.

top_stories.title: Rise in youth unemployment driving more to homelessness, UK charities say | Young people | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Charities** warn that a growing number of young people are becoming homeless or at risk of homelessness, with the youth unemployment rate reaching its highest point in over a decade. A government-commissioned review predicts a 25% rise in young people not in education, employment, or training (Neet) by early 2030s, and **Centrepoint**, a youth homelessness charity, reports that unstable housing is becoming increasingly common as the number of Neets surges.  **Josh**, a 23-year-old struggling to find work and secure stable housing, highlights the challenges young people face in securing employment and affordable housing, emphasizing the need for solutions that address both issues simultaneously. **Lisa Doyle**, head of policy at **Centrepoint**, emphasizes the scarcity of work opportunities for young people while acknowledging the role poverty plays in this crisis.

top_stories.title: Pakistan hires US lobbying firm to advance strategic interests in Washington amid Iran war diplomacy push - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Pakistan** has hired a US lobbying firm, **Ervin Graves Strategy Group**, led by former Republican Congressman Tom Graves, for a two-year contract. The agreement aims to advance Pakistan's diplomatic, economic and strategic interests in Washington, D.C., including monitoring legislative developments and engaging with key stakeholders. The firm will also work to expand Pakistan's engagement with US media and facilitate visits from US lawmakers to Pakistan. This move comes amidst Pakistan's efforts to mediate between **Tehran** and **Washington**.
